q: A quantum channel has zero quantum capacity Q(ε)=0 when:
opts: It is anti-degradable (the complement channel is 'better' than the channel itself)
exp: Anti-degradable channels have Q=0 because the environment (complementary channel) can simulate any output Bob could get. Examples: the quantum erasure channel with ε>1/2, amplitude damping with η<1/2. Unitary channels have Q=1 (maximum).
